tripa.rain.title: Rainfall by the hour
tripa.rain.sub: Pick a place and a day to see when rain is expected.
tripa.rain.pick: Choose a destination to see the hourly rain.
tripa.rain.beyond: This date is more than {days} days away, so there is no hourly forecast. Only the usual pattern from past years is shown.
tripa.err.unknown_dest: That destination is not in the list.
tripa.err.bad_date: That date is not valid. Use a date like 2026-12-20.
tripa.err.past_date: That date has passed. Choose today or a later day.
tripa.err.no_dests: The list of destinations could not be loaded.
tripa.err.no_history: The historical rain data is not available.
tripa.err.no_tendency: There is no historical tendency for this area yet.
tripa.err.forecast: The forecast could not be loaded.
tripa.err.no_hours: The forecast has no hourly values for this day.
tripa.err.compute: The dates could not be worked out. Please try again.
tripa.effect.light: Light rain: most outdoor plans work. Carry a rain jacket.
tripa.effect.moderate: Moderate rain: outdoor activities may be unpleasant. Plan indoor options.
tripa.effect.heavy: Heavy rain: avoid outdoor activities in those hours.
tripa.effect.very_heavy: Very heavy rain: outdoor activities are not advised.
tripa.say.dry: No rain is expected this day.
tripa.say.window: Rain is expected from {from} to {to}, about {amount} in total.
tripa.say.peak: The most rain comes around {time} ({level}, {mm} in the hour).
tripa.say.better: The {period} is the driest part of the day.
tripa.say.chance_high: The chance of rain is high, up to {chance}.
tripa.say.chance_low: The chance of rain is low, at most {chance}.
tripa.say.good_window: A dry stretch is expected from {from} to {to}.
tripa.chart.title: 24 hours at a glance
tripa.chart.alt: Chart of hourly rain, chance of rain and temperature for {name} on {date}. Total rain {total}, highest chance of rain {max}. The values are also in the table below.
tripa.chart.note: Bars: rain in each hour, coloured by level. Blue line: chance of rain. Dashed line: temperature.
tripa.periods.title: Parts of the day
tripa.table.title: Hour-by-hour values
tripa.table.note: Hourly forecast from Open-Meteo (not NASA data). Forecasts become less certain after the first few days.
tripa.tend.p90: Rain on a wet day of the year (top 10%)
tripa.tend.explain: Based on NASA POWER, {period}, days around this date of the year. This is a tendency, not a forecast.
tripa.cmp.title: Compare destinations
tripa.cmp.sub: Put 2 to 6 places side by side for the same dates.
tripa.cmp.pick_first: Choose a destination from the list first.
tripa.cmp.max: You can compare at most {max} destinations.
tripa.cmp.min: Add at least {min} destinations to compare.
tripa.cmp.end_before: The end date must not be before the start date.
tripa.cmp.pick: Choose destinations and dates, then press Compare.
tripa.cmp.err_all: No weather data could be loaded for these destinations and dates.
tripa.cmp.copy_failed: Could not copy. Copy the address from the browser.
tripa.cmp.best_basis_score: Chosen by the suitability score (weather, activities, preferences, environment).
tripa.cmp.best_basis_rain: Chosen by the lowest average rain, because there are no forecast days to score.
tripa.cmp.no_reason: No reasons are available for this choice.
tripa.cmp.tend_only: Only past-year tendencies are available for these dates, so there is no temperature or score.
tripa.cmp.tend_note: Days more than 16 days away use the NASA POWER historical tendency (a usual pattern), not a forecast. They are drawn lighter on the chart.
tripa.cmp.missing_note: Some days have no data and are left out of the averages.
tripa.cmp.rain_note: Solid bars: forecast. Lighter bars: usual rain from past years.
tripa.cmp.temp_note: Only days inside the forecast are shown.
tripa.cmp.hour_title: Rain by the hour for one day
tripa.cmp.no_hourly: No day in this range has an hourly forecast for every destination.
tripa.cmp.daily_table: Daily rain values (text version of the chart)
tripa.cmp.no_map: The map could not be loaded.
tripa.cmp.score_note: The suitability score is a planning guide made from weather, activities, your preferences and the environment. It is not a scientific index.
tripa.chart.rain_alt: Bar chart of daily rain from {start} to {end} for {n} destinations. The same numbers are in the daily values table below.
tripa.chart.chance_alt: Line chart of the daily chance of rain from {start} to {end} for {n} destinations.
tripa.chart.temp_alt: Line chart of the highest daily temperature from {start} to {end} for {n} destinations.
tripa.chart.hour_alt: Line chart of hourly rain on the chosen day for {n} destinations.
tripa.dates.title: Best travel dates
tripa.dates.sub: Find the driest and most comfortable days for your trip.
tripa.dates.ready: Set your wishes and press Find best dates.
tripa.dates.maxrain: Most rain you accept per day (mm, optional)
tripa.dates.original: Compare with dates I already have in mind (optional)
tripa.dates.original_hint: Fill in both dates to see how they compare with the best dates.
tripa.dates.err_duration: The trip must be 1 to {max} days.
tripa.dates.err_short: The search range is shorter than the trip.
tripa.dates.err_original: Enter both of your own dates, with the end not before the start.
tripa.dates.no_forecast: The forecast is not available, so only past-year tendencies are used.
tripa.dates.none: No dates could be ranked in this range.
tripa.dates.tend_note: Based on the NASA POWER historical tendency, not a forecast.
tripa.dates.mixed_note: The first days are a forecast; later days use the historical tendency.
tripa.dates.orig_none: Your dates could not be scored (they may be outside the search range or have no data).
tripa.dates.orig_worse: The best dates ({start} - {end}) score {points} points higher than yours.
tripa.dates.orig_ok: Your dates are as good as the best dates found.
tripa.dates.score_note: Scores are a planning guide, not a scientific index. Near-term results use the forecast (Open-Meteo, not NASA); later results use NASA POWER tendencies.
